messages:
alex: Heads-up: several GPU model-worker streams in az-us-east1a stalled this morning. gRPC sessions hang for ~40-120s then continue. Affected jobs report backpressure and timeouts. Anyone on-call for net? :thinking:

priya: Can you grab `dmesg` / `ip -s link` from the two nodes involved and a quick `ss -tin` for the stuck TCP connections? Suspect MTU or offload weirdness after last week's DPU rollout.

alex: pasted snippets below. low signal but telling: 
```
# n-az1a-03 (gpu host)
eth0 mtu 9000  txqueuelen 1000
GSO/TCP segmentation offload enabled
Kernel log: "ICMP: frag needed and DF set" from 10.11.4.9 -> 10.11.2.3
ss: tcp ESTAB ttl 59 retrans: 120 cwnd: 1

# n-az1a-09 (peer)
eth0 mtu 1500
GSO offloaded but VF configured with mtu 9000 earlier
sysctl net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc = 1 on this host
```
```
(also lots of "retransmit timer expired" around the same time window)
```

sam: that looks like classic PMTU mismatch + TSO/GSO sending large segments that get dropped mid-path. If DF is set and PMTU discovery suppressed you'll see blackholed large frames. gRPC/HTTP2 likes large DATA frames so this surfaces as streaming stalls.

julia: quick mitigation options: 1) clamp TCP MSS on the calico FORWARD chain for encapsulated traffic, 2) flip `net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc=0` on the DPU/VF hosts, 3) temporarily disable TSO/GSO on affected NICs while we reconcile VF/PF MTU. Which combo do we want to roll?

priya: do a canary: daemonset that sets sysctl=0 and installs iptables TCPMSS clamp only on nodes with the mtu mismatch label. Also run `ethtool -k` check in the ds to record offload state. We'll avoid globe sysctl flips until canary verified.

alex: starting ds canary on 2 nodes now. infra-bot triggered deploy id ds-netpatch-2026-03-20-1

infra-bot: deploy/daemonset/ds-netpatch-2026-03-20-1 started by alex (canary nodes: n-az1a-03, n-az1a-09)

sam: i'm grepping logs for "frag needed" and matching against GPU job timestamps. Preliminary: three distinct job hangs line up with these ICMP events in last 24h. Will open INFRA-2179 and add findings.

priya: noted that our node image builder forgot to set VF mtu during the SR-IOV workflow for the new DPU images. Adding a validation test in the AMI pipeline to assert `ip link` mtus and `sysctl` defaults.

julia: longer-term fix: standardize host MTU across fleet (9000) OR force calico to use wire MTU-encap consistently. Also update provisioning docs so SR-IOV binds inherit PF MTU. Ticketing that in INFRA-2140.

alex: canary reports: after ds on two nodes, observed reduced retransmits and ongoing streams recovered on canary hosts. Rolling to remaining az-us-east1a nodes in 10min. Will monitor GPU job success rate.

priya: if we still see intermittent stalls after full roll, disable TSO/GSO for affected NICs and schedule host reboot window to rebind VFs correctly. Add note to runbook: check `ip_no_pmtu_disc` + `ip link` mtus + `ethtool -k` on suspect hosts.

sam: follow-ups: correlate with last week's DPU firmware change; vendor released a patch that changed default VF MTU behavior. Reaching out to vendor support and adding a flag to the node-provisioner to explicit set VF MTU.

alex: thanks all. tagging nodes with `mtu-mismatch=true` and leaving the thread open. Will post metrics (packet loss / retransmits) after full rollout. :white_check_mark:
